42057840.model_description: A letter to the editor discussing a multi-institutional study (Yang and Li) that used convolutional neural networks to extract deep learning radiomics features from preoperative T1/T2 MRI, combined with alpha-fetoprotein and disease stage in a nomogram, to predict event-free survival in pediatric hepatoblastoma.
42057840.headline_result: Model reported to significantly outperform standard clinical predictors (specific metrics not given in this letter)
42057840.study_design: letter to the editor / commentary on an MRI deep learning radiomics study

42058407.clinical_problem: Automated Cobb angle and coronal tilt measurement on standing whole-spine radiographs in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis
42058407.patient_population: 1,200 radiographs for training/validation, 150 independent external test radiographs
42058407.model_description: SpineNET, a lightweight YOLOv13-based keypoint-to-geometry network, detects vertebral/pelvic bounding boxes and anatomical keypoints (trained without Cobb angle supervision) and computes Cobb angle, shoulder tilt, and pelvic coronal tilt via a transparent geometric pipeline.
42058407.headline_result: 94.2% mAP@50; Cobb angle MAE 1.44 degrees, ICC 0.970 vs senior spine surgeon consensus

42059011.exclusion_reason: adult hepatocellular carcinoma study, not pediatric

42062585.exclusion_reason: broad review of imaging modalities (radiography, CT, MRI, PET) for Ewing sarcoma staging and monitoring; AI/radiomics mentioned only briefly near the end, not the review's focus

42062691.exclusion_reason: scoping review of environmental exposure-neuroimaging associations in children; no AI/ML component (conventional statistical associations, not machine learning)

42062943.clinical_problem: Predicting irreducibility of intussusception during air enema in children
42062943.patient_population: 770 irreducible and 1214 reducible cases; real-world test set 46 vs 802, external test 9 vs 101
42062943.model_description: A hybrid ensemble deep learning model trained on air enema fluoroscopic images to objectively predict irreducibility of intussusception, used as a decision-support tool alongside radiologist interpretation.
42062943.dataset_size: 1984 cases for development; real-world test (848), external test (110)
42062943.headline_result: AUC 0.89 (real-world test), 0.883 (external test); outperformed intermediate radiologist (AUC 0.89 vs 0.804, p<0.001) and comparable to senior radiologist
42062943.study_design: retrospective diagnostic accuracy study with external validation

42063928.clinical_problem: Reviewing Doppler ultrasound, 3D vascular indices, and AI integration for placental perfusion assessment and early prediction of preeclampsia
42063928.model_description: A PRISMA-guided structured narrative review of 74 studies on Doppler-based placental perfusion, 3D power Doppler vascular indices (VI, FI, VFI), and AI models trained on voxel-level Doppler data and angiogenic biomarkers for early preeclampsia risk prediction.
42063928.headline_result: AI models trained on voxel-level Doppler data and angiogenic biomarkers achieved AUC 0.85-0.91 for early preeclampsia risk (as summarized from reviewed literature)

42063967.exclusion_reason: deep neural network model based on structured clinical features (including neuroimaging findings coded as a categorical variable) and perinatal risk factors; not image-based AI (no direct image processing)

42064861.clinical_problem: Early prenatal detection of congenital heart disease from fetal echocardiography, integrating imaging with clinical metadata
42064861.model_description: Heartbeat, a multicenter multimodal dataset of fetal cardiac ultrasound images (standard views) and clinical metadata; Heart-ViT, a multimodal transformer integrating imaging features with patient metadata via adaptive layer normalization, was developed for CHD detection, alongside CNN baselines.
42064861.release_evidence: The dataset and analytical framework will be made publicly available to support further research
42064861.headline_result: Heart-ViT: sensitivity 79.17%, specificity 93.18%, AUROC 88.56%, F1 65.63%; 13.22-point F1 improvement over imaging-only baseline
42064861.study_design: multicenter dataset development and model benchmarking study

42065849.model_family: WEKA ensemble classifiers (computer-aided diagnosis system, CADS)
42065849.clinical_problem: Computer-aided diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder using resting-state fMRI functional connectivity, with age-specific classification models
42065849.patient_population: Children, adolescents, and adults with ASD (age-dependent cohorts, dataset size not stated)
42065849.model_description: An age-dependent computer-aided diagnosis system (CADS) using frequency-domain functional connectivity (via group-ICA, dual regression, and coherence analysis) from resting-state fMRI, with separate feature selection and classification for children, adolescent, and adult age groups.

42068700.exclusion_reason: review of prenatal ultrasound scanning education/training methods (simulation, VR/AR, e-learning); AI-driven feedback systems mentioned only briefly, not diagnostic radiology AI

42069836.clinical_problem: Diagnosing ADHD from pediatric brain MRI using an automated, objective imaging-based classifier
42069836.patient_population: Stratified pediatric MRI dataset (size not stated)
42069836.model_description: A biologically informed multi-stream deep learning framework combining a Vision Transformer (ViT) and Enhanced CNN (ECNN), fed raw MRI, phase spectrum transform, and quantile histogram equalization/denoising representations, to classify ADHD from pediatric brain MRI.

42071051.clinical_problem: Forensic/legal age estimation and age-threshold classification (12, 14, 16, 18 years) in living children and young adults using pelvic MRI ossification patterns
42071051.model_description: Machine learning regression models for continuous age estimation and classification models for legal age-threshold determination (12/14/16/18 years), based on staged ossification patterns of the iliac crest and ischial tuberosity on pelvic MRI.
42071051.headline_result: Age regression MAE 2.957y (internal), 2.252y (external); threshold classification AUCs up to 0.977-0.997
42071051.study_design: retrospective study with internal and external validation

42072197.model_family: deep learning multi-task dual-branch segmentation network
42072197.clinical_problem: Segmenting anatomical structures in standard fetal abdominal ultrasound sections to reduce missed diagnoses from unclear organ identification
42072197.patient_population: Fetal abdominal ultrasound images from pregnant women in mid-pregnancy (18-24 weeks)
42072197.model_description: SEG-FAUSP, a deep learning multi-task model with a parallel dual-branch semantic segmentation network, segments core anatomical structures (umbilical veins, gastric bubble, spine, bladder, inferior vena cava) in seven key fetal abdominal ultrasound sections.
42072197.headline_result: IoU >0.84 for bladder and gastric bubble; segmentation of complex structures (e.g., inferior vena cava) significantly superior to baseline

42072255.clinical_problem: Mapping the intellectual structure and growth of AI and deep learning research in pediatric radiology and medical imaging
42072255.model_description: A bibliometric analysis of 2,688 articles and conference proceedings (2005-2025) on AI/deep learning in pediatric radiology, using Bibliometrix R and VOSviewer to map publication growth, thematic clusters, and geographic co-authorship patterns.
42072255.headline_result: Publications grew from 7 (2005) to 559 (2025); most-cited: Kermany et al. 2018 (2886 citations); 8 of top 10 productive affiliations North American
42072255.study_design: bibliometric analysis (Web of Science Core Collection, Bibliometrix/VOSviewer)

42072763.clinical_problem: Detecting 18 thoracic and musculoskeletal pathologies on conventional radiography across adult and pediatric patients
42072763.patient_population: 21,581 adult and pediatric X-rays from 20 countries
42072763.model_description: A unified deep learning radiographic AI suite validated for detecting 18 thoracic and musculoskeletal pathologies on X-rays, with subgroup analysis by age (including pediatric patients), sex, and country of acquisition.
42072763.headline_result: AUC >96.1% across all 18 pathologies; sensitivity 94.5-98.8%, specificity 84.6-96.1%

42072778.exclusion_reason: dental imaging (panoramic radiographs, caries detection), excluded per scope

42073028.clinical_problem: Noninvasive initial risk stratification of pediatric neuroblastoma using MRI radiomics
42073028.model_description: Radiomic features (107 IBSI-compliant features) extracted from manually segmented T2-weighted MRI of pediatric neuroblastoma tumors, classified using Random Forest, XGBoost, and LDA+K-means clustering to stratify high-risk versus non-high-risk disease per INRG criteria.
42073028.headline_result: LDA+K-means: test accuracy 77.8%, sensitivity 64.7%, specificity 85.7%; agreement with conventional risk stratification 77.8%

42073467.clinical_problem: Preoperative differentiation of Wilms tumor from neuroblastoma on pediatric abdominal CT
42073467.model_description: A YOLO26s object-detection model trained on preoperative contrast-enhanced CT images with histopathology-anchored labels to localize and differentiate Wilms tumor from neuroblastoma lesions.
42073467.headline_result: Precision 0.954, recall 0.951, mAP@0.5 0.977; image-level tumor detection accuracy 95.3%

42074871.exclusion_reason: feasibility study of a sedation-free MRI protocol and neurocognitive testing; no AI/ML model (standard volumetric analysis, not machine learning)
